scope: The six requires_regeneration=true items from batch-01 only. Public official teaching frames and static-contact correction prompts. No generated-image approval is granted by this file.

characters.actor: All six retain blue as the demonstrator: approved white-haired adult in blue gi and brown belt.
characters.partner: Approved black-haired adult in white gi and brown belt; both partner trouser legs remain white.

style: Preserve the approved set-01 neutral adult 2.5D anime identity. Use pose references first and approved character/style references last; no default knee-cut composition reuse.

items.name: 기무라 스윕
items.qaReason: 파랑의 두 손이 각각 흰 손목과 흰 전완/소매를 잡는다. 자기 손목을 잡는 킴무라 figure-four 고리가 보이지 않아 스윕의 핵심 그립이 다른 팔 제어로 바뀌었다.
items.selectedVariant: The Grappling Academy closed-guard Kimura/hip-bump combination, established figure-four branch
items.posePhase: Static established-contact instant before sweep or submission continuation
items.sourceTitle: The Kimura Hip Bump Sweep - Kimura Combo
items.inspectionMethod: Public player frame read through CUA, then local cache directly opened with view_image
keyChecks: One blue hand holds the white wrist; the second blue hand unmistakably holds BLUE OWN opposite wrist after that arm wraps over the white upper arm.
The connected forearms form one closed figure-four with the white elbow bent; two blue hands separately grabbing white do not pass.
Blue remains in bottom guard control and the established hand loop is large enough to distinguish at 224px.
items.composition224: Three-quarter view from the hand-lock side, with the two wrist contacts near the image center. Keep the blue self-wrist contact against white fabric for contrast; far feet may remain naturally occluded.
items.correctedEnglishPrompt: Show blue angled on the side in bottom guard against a kneeling white partner, at the established Kimura control stage before the sweep continuation. One blue hand grips white's wrist. The other blue arm loops over white's upper arm, and its hand grips BLUE'S OWN opposite wrist, completing a closed figure-four. Keep white's elbow bent and both gripping hands visibly distinct. Use a close three-quarter view from the lock side so the self-wrist contact reads at 224px. Preserve natural occlusion of nonessential far limbs rather than spreading the bodies apart.
items.sourceScope: Direct official educator demonstration. The selected static contacts were inspected; the entire video and dynamic success were not audited.
limitations: The selected frame verifies the actual figure-four branch of the Kimura/hip-bump combination, not a completed dynamic sweep.
Source athletes wear similar rashguards; remap the bottom instructor to blue gi and the kneeling partner to white gi.
technicalNotes: Reject v1-style double control of the white forearm: the second hand must visibly return to a blue wrist.

items.name: 러버 가드

items.name: 엑스가드
items.qaReason: 두 파란 발이 흰 한쪽 다리에 닿지만 반대 방향의 위·아래 X 훅과 다른 흰 다리의 어깨 지지가 구분되지 않는다. 자연스러운 가림 때문에 다리 자체 오류라고 단정하지 않지만 X가드의 핵심 구조 확인에 부족하다.

keyChecks: One white leg is collected at the blue shoulder and upper-body connection.
Both blue feet hook the OTHER white leg at different heights: upper hook near the hip/groin and lower hook behind the knee, with opposing directions.
The shoulder-supported leg remains separate from the hooked leg; a single-leg-X or two soles pushing one hip does not pass.
items.composition224: Low-to-mid three-quarter view from the open hook side. Keep a small negative-space gap between upper ankle, lower ankle, and the white knee; maintain the separate shoulder-supported leg in the same view.
items.correctedEnglishPrompt: Show blue below white's standing base in conventional X guard. One white leg rests against blue's shoulder and is retained by the upper-body connection. Blue's two feet hook the OTHER white leg at different heights: the upper hook near the hip and groin, the lower hook behind the knee, opposing each other to form the X structure. Use a three-quarter view from the open hook side, leaving visible separation around both blue ankles and the white knee. Freeze a stable base, with the supported leg distinguishable from the hooked leg.
items.sourceScope: Direct official educator demonstration. The selected static contacts were inspected; the entire video and dynamic success were not audited.
limitations: The source top athlete wears blue and the bottom athlete gray; remap the bottom guard player to blue and the top partner to white.
The source arm uses an overhook; maintain that compatible shoulder-control variant rather than adding another arm.

items.name: 리버스 델라히바 가드
items.qaReason: 발목 그립과 반대 발의 힙 프레임은 보이나, 안쪽에서 들어가 흰 앞다리 무릎 뒤/바깥으로 감기는 reverse-DLR 훅이 드러나지 않는다. 열린 가드의 발목 제어 그림과 구분이 어렵다.

The blue ankle-control hand belongs to that same leading white leg.
The non-hooking leg retains the source distance frame; the inside shin-to-instep route must remain distinct from ordinary outside De La Riva.
items.composition224: Knee-level inside-front three-quarter view, with the leading white knee centered. Place the blue hooking instep just beyond the knee silhouette so its return path remains visible at 224px; do not expose every far limb.
items.correctedEnglishPrompt: Show blue on the side beneath white's bent leading knee in reverse De La Riva control before inversion. Blue's hooking leg enters from INSIDE white's legs, with its shin beside the inner knee and its instep wrapping behind that knee toward the outside. Blue's ankle-control hand grips the same white leg. Keep the other blue leg as the source distance frame. Use a knee-level inside-front three-quarter view that exposes the hooking foot beyond the knee silhouette, with enough separation to read its return path at 224px.
items.sourceScope: Direct official educator demonstration. The selected static contacts were inspected; the entire video and dynamic success were not audited.
limitations: The original close body connection partly overlaps the instep; the new composition must expose this defining hook without changing the source inside-entry route.
The source is no-gi; map the bottom instructor to blue gi and the standing partner to white gi.
technicalNotes: The calf, foot, and ankle-control hand must all belong to one coherent hooked-leg relationship.

items.qaReason: 팔을 감는 파란 발과 흰 힙을 미는 파란 발 외에 오른쪽 아래로 파란 바짓단과 발이 하나 더 보인다. 세 번째 파란 하체 또는 흰 선수 다리의 도복색/소속 오류로 읽혀 해부학·색 연결을 고쳐야 한다.

Blue has exactly TWO leg routes: the lasso leg and the separate opposite-shoulder frame selected from this source.
White owns two WHITE trouser legs continuing from the white hips; no extra blue cuff or third blue foot is introduced.
items.composition224: Three-quarter view from the lasso side, with the sleeve grip, arm loop, and second blue leg separated. Omit the source foreground observer; only the two approved characters appear.
items.correctedEnglishPrompt: Show blue in the selected deep-lasso guard beneath a forward-leaning white partner. Blue holds one white sleeve while the corresponding blue leg circles around that arm and places the foot behind the upper-arm and armpit line. Blue's second leg remains a separate opposite-shoulder frame, matching this representative source. Trace exactly two blue legs from blue's hips and two WHITE trouser legs from white's hips. Use a three-quarter lasso-side view with the loop and sleeve grip readable at 224px. Include only the two approved characters; omit the source observer.

items.sourceScope: Direct official educator demonstration. The selected static contacts were inspected; the entire video and dynamic success were not audited.
limitations: The instructor deliberately lifts the low leg around 2:37 to demonstrate an error; that candidate was rejected and removed from this task cache. The selected main frame is 2:42 with the leg down.
The main frame includes an explanatory hand gesture; use the same-video 2:15 auxiliary frame only to retain the actual sleeve grip.
The upper shin is partly overlapped by the partner in the source camera view; the new camera must clarify it without replacing it with a sole-on-hip frame.
technicalNotes: Only one coherent static setup should be illustrated; do not combine the leg-raised counterexample with the correct flat-leg position.

technicalClarifications: Rubber guard uses the observed cross-body ankle-supporting arm, distinct from the knee-hugging arm; same-side hand is not imposed.
The selected Meregali lasso example uses a separate opposite-shoulder frame, not an extra hip-framing leg.
The 2:37 scissors counterexample with the low leg lifted was rejected; the selected main frame is 2:42 with the low leg down.
The Kimura reference verifies the established figure-four stage of the named Kimura/hip-bump combination; no dynamic sweep success is claimed.
